data.name: Shekh
data.gender_notes: Shekh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is a lord, master, or ruler. The name Shekh carries the meaning “Lord, Master” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shekh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord, master and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Shekh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord, Master.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shekh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.context: Shekh is most famously known as the Sultan Ahmad Nizam Shah I, founder of the Nizam Shahi dynasty.
